messages.subject: Cannot plot simple series
messages.body_plain:
This is my first day with RKWard and my third day with Linux
(Kubuntu), so please bear with me.

RKWard is running well and has dealt with quite complex code. I am
very excited about using it. However, it has not been able to plot
even the simplest charts. It also was not able to plot charts
generated by ggplot2, even though that code worked fine in RGui and
RStudio. Here is an example of a chart using base R:

> zz <- 1:100
> plot(zz)

Here is the error generated:

Error in RK() : Graphics API version mismatch
4: RK()
3: dev.hold()
2: plot.default(zz)
1: plot(zz)

Any help will be greatly appreciated,

messages.body_plain:
hi,

Am Montag, 16. August 2021, 23:41:29 CEST schrieb Fernando Saldanha:
> Error in RK() : Graphics API version mismatch

this is probably due to CRAN R being incompatible with the latest binaries 
from our PPAs. i've requested rebuilds for all R 4.* binaries, please try to 
fetch an update of RKWard within the next few hours and let us know if the 
rebuild made the issue go away.


viele grüße :: m.eik

I think It's a known bug, you'll have to compile RKward 0.7.3 develop
version with R 4.1.X or wait for the new binary version to be released.
I hope this helps:
https://bugs.kde.org/show_bug.cgi?id=438993
https://rkward.kde.org/RKWard_Source_Repository.html
and
https://rkward.kde.org/Building_RKWard_From_Source.html
Cheers, let us know how it goes.

> from our PPAs. i've requested rebuilds for all R 4.* binaries, please try to
> fetch an update of RKWard within the next few hours and let us know if the
> rebuild made the issue go away.

in the meantime, we managed also to fix an issue with the version numbering of 
the PPA packages that affected users of ubuntu versions newer than 20.04, 
resulting in those packages being seen as a downgrade. if you're using one of 
our PPAs with those ubuntu versions, you should now be offered an updated 
version of RKWard, too. ejoy :)


viele grüße :: m.eik
